finalText:
**4.2.0 entry added** to [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), same shape as 4.1.0.

380 commits, mostly dep bumps and refactors. Real user-facing changes: one breaking (expired tokens now `401`, was `403`), one feature (webhook retries with backoff), nine fixes — null-cursor crashes on pagination, empty-allowlist rejections, double-trimmed trailing slashes, dropped trace ids on retry, an HTTP client timer leak and unclean pool shutdown, duplicate response headers, wrong histogram units, full request bodies in db logs, and unclear token-parser errors.

Next: sanity-check the `401`/`403` call, some clients may depend on the old code.
